automations.description: Automations associated with the AI Index.

date_created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the AI Index was created.

date_modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the AI Index was last modified.

description.description: Human-readable description of the AI Index.

type.description: The type of the backing store.

value.description: The data stream or index the AI Index is attached to.

dest.description: The data stream or index that backs the AI Index.

agent_id.description: Agent Builder agent ID that runs the analysis.

allowed_actions.description: Improvement actions the analysis may propose.

enabled.description: Whether the recurring feedback analysis is desired to run.

interval.description: How often to analyze, for example `1h`.

signal_filter.description: KQL narrowing which signals the analysis reads.

from.description: Date math relative to now, for example `now-30d`.
ISO 8601 date to analyze signals since.

feedback_analysis.description: The recurring feedback analysis, which reads agent signals and proposes improvement actions for the AI Index.

id.description: The unique identifier of the AI Index.

managed.description: Whether the AI Index is managed by a plugin and therefore immutable.

type.description: `esql` for an ES|QL query, or `connector` for a data connector.

value.description: An ES|QL query for `esql`, or a connector ID for `connector`.

sources.description: Additional sources that provide context for the AI Index.

query.description: The ES|QL query derived from this trace source at read time.

type.description: `elastic_agent` for an Agent Builder agent, `index` for an index or data stream name or pattern, or `esql` for an ES|QL query.

traces.description: Trace sources linked to this AI Index, each with its derived ES|QL query.

ai_indices.description: The AI Indices available to the caller in the current space.
